title: From Heuristic Selection to Automated Algorithm Design: LLMs Benefit from Strong Priors
abstract: arXiv:2603.02792v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have already been widely adopted for automated algorithm design, demonstrating strong abilities in generating and evolving algorithms across various fields. Existing work has largely focused on examining their effectiveness in solving specific problems, with search strategies primarily guided by adaptive prompt designs. In this paper, through investigating the token-wise attribution of the prompts to LLM-generated algorithmic code, we show that the embedded code examples and their associated strategy instructions have the strongest influence on the generated algorithms. Building upon this insight, we propose leveraging existing benchmark algorithms as strong priors to guide LLM-driven optimization. We evaluate this approach with three LLMs on two black-box optimization benchmarks: the pseudo-Boolean optimization suite (pbo) and the black-box optimization suite (bbob). translated_title: 从启发式选择到自动化算法设计：大语言模型受益于强先验
translated_abstract: 大语言模型已被广泛应用于自动化算法设计，在各个领域生成和演化算法方面展现出强大的能力。现有工作主要集中于考察其在解决特定问题上的有效性，而搜索策略主要由自适应的提示词设计来引导。本文通过研究提示词中各 token 对 LLM 生成算法代码的归因影响，发现提示词中嵌入的代码示例及其相关的策略指令对生成的算法具有最强的影响力。基于这一洞察，我们提出利用现有的基准算法作为强先验来引导 LLM 驱动的优化。我们在两个黑盒优化基准——伪布尔优化套件和黑盒优化套件上，使用三个大语言模型对这一方法进行了评估。尽管仅依赖于简单的 (1+1) 精英……
tldr: 本文通过 token 级归因分析发现提示词中嵌入的代码示例和策略指令对 LLM 生成的算法影响最大，并据此提出将现有基准算法作为强先验来引导 LLM 进行自动化算法设计，在伪布尔和黑盒优化基准上验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: Through token-wise attribution analysis, this paper shows that embedded code examples and strategy instructions in prompts most strongly influence LLM-generated algorithms, and proposes leveraging existing benchmark algorithms as strong priors to guide LLM-driven automated algorithm design, validated on pseudo-Boolean and black-box optimization benchmarks.
